name: Fragment Dissonant
description: Paradoxe Final brisant les lois fondamentales de la réalité sur un secteur entier rendant chaque action imprévisible et chaque défense obsolète.

subject.archetype: Fragment Dissonant — Incursion Dissonante Legendary class furtif

loadout.armor_outfit: Fragmented armor with each plate phasing at different dimensions and times out of sync with reality, impossible geometries connecting segments creating shapes mind cannot process, unnatural spectrum colors shifting and glitching randomly, portions flickering between solid and translucent ghostly state in rapid succession with legendary cosmic materials and ancient craftsmanship that has become one with the wearer's being
loadout.arsenal: Reality-fracturing blade cutting through dimensional barriers leaving visible spatial tears trailing where physics breaks down, paradox generator causing multiple versions of weapon to phase in and out simultaneously from different angles, glitch emitter integrated into off-hand disrupting enemy targeting at quantum level creating visual distortion fields The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's death ability targeting enemy_on_capture, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Being captured but reaching back with final curse, massive devastating dark energy flowing from captured body into captor's position as vengeful last act before being taken
attitude.emotion: Transcendent purpose — no longer merely fighting but reshaping the battlefield itself with every movement and breath

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Magenta Glitch
palette_names.role: primary_accent — reality fracture edges and distortion boundaries

palette_names.name: Fractured Green
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — dimensional tear cores and anomaly centers

palette_names.name: Chromatic Aberration Rainbow
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — visual artifacts where colors separate and bleed

color_and_light.lighting_setup: aurum-plated frame with living energy flowing through ornate faction-specific patterns, border radiates golden glow, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Cinematic ultra-wide angle with dramatic depth layers — foreground devastation, character as glowing focal point, background cataclysm, sky and environment permanently altered

scenography.setting: Reality collapse zone with environment fragmenting into multiple parallel versions simultaneously, buildings existing in two dimensions at once showing both intact and destroyed overlapping states, sky displaying conflicting celestial bodies that should not coexist, gravity malfunctioning causing debris to fall upward and sideways in different zones, ground cracking open revealing parallel battlefields layered on each other like corrupt image
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Malevolent curse energy crawling up captor from point of contact, visible dark tendrils of corruption spreading across their body and position with malignant effect, Ground around captor darkening and dying as curse takes hold, corruption spreading from contact point showing the price of victory, Reality shattering like cracked glass across scene with fragments revealing parallel dimensions, chromatic aberration tearing colors apart at high speed creating RGB separation, objects phasing in and out mid-explosion with parts appearing and disappearing, gravity distorting sending debris every direction simultaneously, temporal stutter showing same motion frozen in multiple positions at once creating ghost trails
